Per the Itanium ABI the key function is the class's FIRST DECLARED virtual (InitResources, slot 0), not just any virtual defined out-of-line in the TU -- confirmed empirically here: the compiled object has zero .data sections, imports _ZTV4Tree as UNDEFINED, and references no _ZTI/_ZTS symbol at all (own or inherited), even though three of six virtuals are real methods.
